claim: A source-built GPL dedicated host can load the recovered campaign without Steam or foreground focus, and corpus-specific solo/co-op trees prevent incompatible Xbox and PC skeleton families from shadowing one another.

diagnostic_host.kind: locally built upstream DOOM-3 GPL dedicated executable
diagnostic_host.purpose: headless loader/crash/idle diagnostics while the retail Steam executable is unavailable
limits: The local GPL source tree contains uncommitted compiler-modernization changes and is not the campaign implementation repository.
A dedicated server exercises multiplayer game semantics and cannot establish single-player presentation or gameplay fidelity.
This host does not replace the eventual retail visual playthrough or two-peer co-op acceptance run.

corpus_isolation.reason: The co-op Xbox actor family uses 48-joint meshes/animations while stock PC solo actors use 62-joint assets at overlapping virtual paths; one unified fs_game can shadow a valid family with the incompatible one.

native_findings.finding: Removing every map-script include from a generated bridge is invalid. Only the exact stock-PC map scripts compiled by doom_main may be removed; Xbox segment-specific principal scripts must remain included so namespaced worldspawn calls resolve.
native_findings.resolution: The overlay generator now emits a principal include only when stock doom_main does not already compile that exact virtual path, and the test-tree merger removes only an enumerated stock-PC include.

native_findings.finding: The Xbox Pinky definition names glassbreak_idle.md5anim, which is absent from the stock PC PK4s. Doom rejects the complete modelDef when that member cannot load, also hiding the shipped glassbreak.md5anim required by Admin.
native_findings.observed_failure: vv/admin spawned and remained alive but ended the idle with Can't find anim 'glassbreak'
native_findings.resolution: Remove only the unshipped glassbreak_idle model animation declaration; preserve the shipped glassbreak cinematic declaration and all frame commands.

acceptance_state.next_gate: Complete the 41-map solo and 20-map co-op 60-second headless sweeps, repair every logged defect, then repeat clean before foreground gameplay testing.
